trend: Our own Instagram: nutritionist series part 2, the Skip list (17 Nov)
why: Carries the Instagram series to X with no product or dose, and asks a question people enjoy answering.
text:
Part 2 of our nutritionist's series is the skip list: BCAAs, melatonin, detox drinks and fat burners.

Each one is overhyped, thinly researched or hard on the stomach, so the money goes further on sleep, fibre and the basics.

What's one supplement you stopped buying?
